integrity: Self-contained combinatorial proof with two replayable finite checks. Finite tests do not establish the all-length theorem independently.
scientific_limitations: Only height-at-most-two Dyck words; oriented overlapping counts of all factor lengths one through four; no noisy-channel, higher-height, unordered-composition, or full fiber-size claim.
title: Exact four-factor reconstruction profiles of height-two Dyck words
